findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess command execution
 * @description Finding subprocess calls that could be vulnerable to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-injection-calls
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "Popen", "check_output", "check_call"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command execution via subprocess. Check for command injection if user input flows here."
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess command execution calls that could be vulnerable to command injection if user input flows to command arguments

message.text: Potential command execution via subprocess. Check for command injection if user input flows here.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe evaluation in markdown-it-py
 * @description Checking for eval, exec, or other dynamic code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-evaluation
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution function call"
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe evaluation functions (eval, exec) or command execution in markdown parser

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution function call
